message:
fix(apk-0232 r3, picker N1): the local pick's completion and a cancel / new Prepare are one boundary

Codex codex_apk_prelogin_select_src_r2.md N1 (the last boundary). The poll read 'still this selection' and
'bound by G' under the sink's lock, released it, then recorded the panel: a nativeAbortVideoSwitch or a new
Prepare (sink only) could finish in that gap and the cancelled pick was still recorded selected.
Now ClientEncodedFrameSink::CommitLocalSelectionFor judges and records in one step under the sink's own
selection state (the Android sink's LockedState, the one Prepare/Abort take): a cancel lands wholly before
(nothing completes) or wholly after (a completion already recorded). Lock order local -> sink -> panel only.
